args.query: structlog JSON logging in FastAPI with request id bound to every log line

results.title: FastAPI request ids in structlog contextvars, tested with capture_logs
results.summary: Pure ASGI middleware binds a request id into structlog contextvars, echoes it in an X-Request-ID header, and is tested offline with TestClient and structlog.testing.capture_logs.

results.title: structlog JSONRenderer routed through stdlib logging, captured in pytest
results.summary: Configure structlog to render one JSON line per event via stdlib logging and ProcessorFormatter, then cover the pytest side offline: caplog holds the event dict (not the JSON), format_exc_info keeps tracebacks JSON-safe, passing default= to JSONRenderer disables the __structlog__ hook, and reconfiguring never stacks handlers.

results.title: structlog bound logger contextvars + stdlib ProcessorFormatter
results.summary: One JSON ProcessorFormatter renders both structlog events and foreign stdlib records while per-request contextvars bound with bind_contextvars are merged in, tested offline by capturing the log stream.

results.title: FastAPI Jinja2 full pages vs HTMX partials via HX-Request
results.summary: Serve a full HTML page to normal browsers and a bare HTML fragment to HTMX requests, chosen by the HX-Request header, with Vary set for caches. Tested offline with the sync TestClient.

results.title: FastAPI metrics with prometheus_client scraped as text
results.summary: Instrument FastAPI with prometheus_client using a per-app registry, label by route template to bound cardinality, and scrape the text exposition format offline through httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy 2 on aiosqlite, tested offline with per-test in-memory DBs
results.summary: A FastAPI app using AsyncSession and async_sessionmaker on aiosqlite, tested with httpx.AsyncClient over ASGITransport, overriding the session dependency with a fresh in-memory database for each test.

results.title: FastAPI routes wired to a dependency-injector DeclarativeContainer, tested offline
results.summary: Build a DeclarativeContainer with Configuration, Singleton and Factory providers, wire it into FastAPI routes with @inject and Depends(Provide[...]), and test it in-process with httpx.ASGITransport.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints rate limited with slowapi, tested with TestClient
results.summary: Add per-route and per-API-key rate limits to FastAPI with slowapi, then test 429 behavior offline with TestClient and the in-memory store.

results.title: FastAPI + Stripe webhook signature verification
results.summary: Verify Stripe webhook signatures in FastAPI from the raw request body and dispatch on event type. Tested offline with locally signed payloads.

results.title: FastAPI endpoints cached with cashews in-memory backend
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by a cashews mem:// cache with key templates, TTL and explicit invalidation, tested fully offline through httpx ASGITransport.
